name: verification-integration
goal: The branch preserves cold public API imports, canonical planning references and decoded design images while enforcing component evidence and task completion.

evidence: The broad committed run exposes a cold public API import of an undeclared Svelte compiler, planning references filtered by helper display rules, and design URLs revoked before their DOM image detaches. Existing tests demonstrate these failures.

Packed-consumer, project-run-references and image-url standardized coverage already owns these paths. Extend it with actual exported plan auditing, a canonical registry assertion and a DOM-safe release assertion; preserve browser error collection.

Sealed red 8eb5477ec298158655f1ecb6c4184d57127af3c338cb801a81d204e98e0733bd at 11b40b3a reproduces the cold package import, missing private planning reference, early image release and seven-category mobile overflow using the standardized tests.

Bundle undeclared compiler dependencies in Node SDK output, derive proposal references from canonical registry metadata, defer URL revocation until Svelte detaches images, and fit all seven phone navigation targets without reducing their touch height.

Fixed Node bundle dependency boundaries, canonical proposal references, DOM-safe blob URL cleanup and seven-category phone layout. Local Harness guidance now requires packed cold-call acceptance, canonical fixture coverage and image replacement/unmount checks.

Sealed green ab307cb9716d796b379882f0a6c1af1f4f72c814ecaf83187e34c9cdf58410bc at f5ff44ea passes the unchanged packed consumer, seven desktop reference/lifecycle checks and mobile navigation assertion.

The sealed red commit replays the original missing compiler, filtered private identity, immediate revocation and off-screen category. Its unchanged frozen command passes after the separate source-only repair.
